listing.name: Onslaught Sleek + Other Onslaughts
listing.summary: A mod made by me and <@142370041839484928> ,with the sprite provided by <@312119593089105921> we present Onslaught sleek a prototype Hegemony Onslaught that was never supposed to see production besides for a test demonstration! It now circulates through merc fleets and markets but at a very rare chance so be on the lookout in them markets and possibly take a shot at the merc fleet to try out this baby for yourself!
listing.aiSummary: Adds a prototype Hegemony Onslaught ship that appears in merc fleets and markets, along with bounty fleets that can be fought and captured.

description: Introduces a rare prototype Hegemony Onslaught ship that circulates through merc fleets and markets. Players can encounter and fight bounty fleets to claim the ship for themselves. The mod includes multiple bounty ships with custom portraits and balancing updates.

changelog.1.5: Ship polygons have been edited to look nicer and added 4 new bounties to the sector so go out there and end their chaos and claim em for your own! NOTE VERSION 1.5 IS NOT SAVE COMPATIBLE WITH VERSIONS 1.0 THROUGH 1.4 I AM SORRY I NEEDED TO ORGANIZE THE FILE NAMES
changelog.1.4: Even more balancing bounty's have their own custom portraits NEW BOUNTY SHIP TO FIGHT AND OBTAIN still save compatible
